title: Nano Coating Wax – Ceramic Protection for Car & Boat
descriptionHtml:
Shine and protection in a single step

Regular wax wears off after a few washes and the paint quickly turns dull again. Dirt and water stick easily and the car looks drab.

Ceramic protection that lasts

The ceramic nano formula builds a glossy, water-repellent layer on the paint. Water beads off and dirt has a harder time sticking, so the car stays clean longer.

Features

  • Ceramic protection with high gloss
  • Water-repellent – water beads off
  • Makes it harder for dirt to stick
  • For cars, boats, motorhomes and yachts
  • Easy to apply in one step

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
